newFactsLearned.fact: The exact 'oldText' string specified in 'patch-1' of the remediation plan was not found in the 'pom.xml' file with the 'expectedOccurrences' of 1.

recommendedFocusForPlanner: Review the exact content of the 'pom.xml' file to identify the correct 'oldText' for the target dependency version property.
Ensure the 'expectedOccurrences' value in the next patch plan accurately reflects the number of times the 'oldText' appears in the file.
Do not repeat the same patch unless refreshed project analyzer evidence confirms the correct 'oldText' and 'expectedOccurrences'.
